title: Territorial authority boundaries in Landonline Web Search, 2025
sourceName: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand
credit: Source: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand, licensed for re-use under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Web display copy resized and converted to WebP.
altText: New Zealand territorial authority boundaries overlaid in LINZ Web Search mapping.
caption: Territorial authority boundaries displayed in LINZ Web Search as an additional governmental spatial layer, published in its service release notes.
context: A real government spatial data display demonstrating integration of cadastral and territorial-authority boundaries. The screenshot belongs to a 2025 release and should not be used to represent earlier government GIS software.
derivativesNote: Local original stored unchanged; WebP display width up to 1600 pixels and thumbnail width up to 720 pixels, resized without cropping.
